persons.name: Kānhajī
persons.evidence: dvivedī kānhajītatputra (!) someśvara umābhyāṃ pitā putrābhyāṃ militvā liṣitoyaṃ (!) graṃthaḥ

persons.name: Someśvara
persons.evidence: dvivedī kānhajītatputra (!) someśvara umābhyāṃ pitā putrābhyāṃ militvā liṣitoyaṃ (!) graṃthaḥ

date.as_written: saṃvat 1775 varṣe māse bhādrapade kṛṣṇapakṣe caturthī caṃdravāsare

notes: Both father (dvivedī Kānhajī) and son (Someśvara) jointly copied the manuscript ('pitā putrābhyāṃ militvā liṣitoyaṃ', where 'umābhyāṃ' is a corruption of 'ubhābhyāṃ'). Avaṃtīnagara is classical Avantī (modern Ujjain).
